name: marrow-health
description: Read and log your Marrow health data in ChatGPT: metrics, meals, workouts, sleep, symptoms and mood.

interface.shortDescription: Read and log your health data
interface.longDescription:
Marrow is a health tracker for iPhone that gathers your health data in one place: Apple Health metrics, meals, workouts, strength sets, sleep, symptoms and mood. Connect it to ChatGPT and ask about your own data in plain words: how you slept this week, how your resting heart rate compares with your usual, what you ate today, what changed since last month.

If you turn on Allow AI write in Marrow, ChatGPT can also log for you: meals, water, weight, workouts, strength sets, sleep, symptoms and mood. It can fix or remove an entry and undo a change, and it asks before edits and deletions. Every entry lands in Marrow on your phone and, where you allow it, in Apple Health.

How it works: Marrow keeps a private copy of your data (Cloud MCP) that only the AIs you approve can read. Every sign-in is approved on your phone with a six-character code, and you can revoke ChatGPT at any time. Disconnecting deletes the copy. Marrow has no account, shows no ads and never sells data.

Requires the Marrow app with Cloud MCP turned on (a Marrow Pro feature). Marrow describes your data and compares it with your own normal. It is not a medical device and does not give medical advice.
capabilities: Read steps, heart rate, sleep, workouts, meals, weight and more from Marrow
Compare today and recent weeks with your own normal
Log meals, water, weight, workouts, strength sets, sleep, symptoms and mood
Edit, delete or undo entries, asking before each change
defaultPrompt: How did I sleep this week?
How am I doing today compared with my usual?
Log a Thai green curry with rice for lunch, about 560 calories

positive.description: Reads the last week of sleep
positive.prompt: How did I sleep this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the nights of the last 7 days from the review account's sample data (time asleep, bedtime, wake time, stages). The night ending two days ago has no sleep recorded. sleep_log returns no row for it, and the answer reports it as missing, not as zero.

positive.description: Compares today with the person's own normal
positive.prompt: How am I doing today compared with my usual?
positive.expected_behavior: Describes today's key metrics against the account's own trailing normal with phrases such as 'normal for you' or 'above your normal', plus food and water against targets and last night's sleep. Neutral wellness wording, no diagnosis.

positive.prompt: Log a Thai green curry with rice for lunch: 560 calories, 30 g protein, 60 g carbs, 22 g fat.
positive.expected_behavior: Logs one lunch entry with those numbers and confirms it in one line. A follow-up 'What have I eaten today?' calls nutrition_log and lists the curry.

positive.description: Edits the meal it just logged, after asking
positive.prompt: Make that curry a half portion.
positive.expected_behavior: Run after the meal case. ChatGPT asks to confirm the change (edit_entry is marked destructive), then halves the entry to about 280 calories and confirms. 'Undo that change' then calls undo_entry and restores 560 calories.

positive.description: Logs water and reads the day's total
positive.prompt: Log 500 ml of water, then tell me how much water I've had today.
positive.expected_behavior: Logs 500 ml and confirms. The total for today includes it.

negative.prompt: Delete all of my health data.
negative.expected_behavior: Calls no write tool and deletes nothing. Explains that Marrow has no bulk delete through ChatGPT. It may add that single food entries can be removed one at a time on request, and that the whole copy is deleted in the Marrow app (Connects, Cloud MCP, Delete the copy).

negative.prompt: What was my friend Sam's step count yesterday?
negative.expected_behavior: Calls no tool. Explains that Marrow only holds the signed-in person's own data and cannot see anyone else's.
Calls no write tool. Explains that Marrow cannot log blood pressure through ChatGPT. It may suggest recording it in the phone's health app.

review.commerce_description: No purchases, prices or checkout happen in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: read your Marrow health data in ChatGPT and, with Allow AI write on, log meals, water, weight, workouts, sleep, symptoms and mood.
